fact: The Liberia ICT Policy (2019-2024) is a five-year policy replacing the 2010 policy, assigns the Ministry of Posts and Telecommunications to coordinate, and is to be reviewed annually by a multi-stakeholder team; its period ended in 2024.
title: Liberia Information and Communications Technology (ICT) Policy (2019-2024)
publisher: Liberia Telecommunications Authority (host); Government of Liberia
